activity_downloaded_episode: S{season} · E{episode} is on this device
approve_code_bad: A code is six letters and digits, like K7F-Q2M.
approve_code_lead: Enter the code shown on the device’s screen.
approve_consent: It will sign in as {name} and can play anything in your library. You can remove it any time in Settings.
approve_done_lead: {device} is signing in now. You can close this tab.
approve_failed: Couldn’t reach the server, so nothing was approved. Try again.
approve_lead: Check that this code matches the one on the device’s screen.
approve_not_found: No device is waiting with that code. It may have expired or already been approved.
detail_lang_hint_series: Applies to every season, including new episodes.
detail_lang_unavailable: The tracks of this file aren’t ready yet.
detail_not_found: This title isn't in your library.
detail_wanted_synopsis: Not in your library yet. Streamline is searching for a release.
dl_ask_body: {episodes} · {size} come off this device. You can download them again any time.
dl_cause_no_space: Not enough space on this computer
dl_empty_text: Tap the download icon on a movie or episode to watch it without a connection.
dl_finished_offline: Finished offline · syncs when you’re back online
dl_note_converted_many: The server converts them to {quality} first, so the download takes longer to start.
dl_note_converted_one: The server converts it to {quality} first, so the download takes longer to start.
dl_note_original: The file as it is on the server: {video}. Nothing is converted.
dl_offline_detail: Downloads still play. What you watch is saved on this device and syncs when you’re back online.
dl_pick_remember: Use these choices for every download without asking
dl_settings_pick_desc: Asks which audio and subtitle tracks to take with it. Off takes your audio and subtitle languages.
dl_settings_quality_desc: Lower qualities are transcoded on the server before they download.
dl_toast_offline_text: Downloads still play. Progress syncs when you’re back.
dl_toast_synced: Synced what you watched offline · {n} downloads
dl_toast_synced_one: Synced what you watched offline · 1 download
dl_watched_to: Watched to {time} offline · syncs when you’re back online
halt_alts_title: Or start now, without a conversion
halt_busy_body: All conversions on {host} are in use, and this stream needs one.
halt_busy_body_need: All conversions on {host} are in use, and this stream needs one ({need}).
halt_busy_note: You’re at {at}. Playback starts as soon as a slot frees up.
halt_missing_body: Streamline can’t find it where the library expects it. It may have been moved, renamed or deleted.
halt_missing_note: Let your admin know. If it was moved, a library scan finds it again.
halt_missing_title: This file isn’t on the server
halt_nocodec_body: {player} can’t decode this file’s video, and the server can’t convert it: {message}.
halt_nocodec_note: Play it on another device, or ask your admin to turn on software conversion.
halt_offline_body: This picks up as soon as it’s back.
halt_offline_body_at: Playback picks up at {at} as soon as it’s back.
halt_offline_wait: Waiting for a network · checking every {secs} s
halt_restart_count_at: Reconnecting in {left} s · picks up at {at}
halt_stop_note_at: You were at {at}. Your place is saved.
halt_unreachable_body: The server may be off or restarting, or this device is away from your home network without the VPN.
halt_unreachable_count_at: Trying again in {left} s · your place is saved at {at}
home_empty_text: Titles appear here as soon as they are added to Streamline.
home_error_network: Can’t reach the server. Check your connection, or try again in a moment.
home_error_server: The server couldn’t answer. Try again in a moment.
person_not_found: This person isn't in your library.
player_audio_delay_earlier: Sound plays earlier than the picture.
player_audio_delay_later: Sound plays later than the picture.
player_audio_note_convert: {player} can’t decode {name}, so the server converts it to {out}.
player_next_starts_when_filled: Next episode starts when this fills
player_night_mode_desc: Evens out loud and quiet scenes
player_note_audio_transcode: Original video. The server converts the audio to {audio} ({why}).
player_note_direct: Playing the original file as-is. Nothing is converted.
player_note_remux: Original video and audio, repackaged for {player} ({container} → fMP4). Nothing is converted.
player_note_transcode: The server converts the video to {video} ({why}).
player_quality_same_as_original: Same as Original · the file is {size}
player_style_note_burn: Burned-in subtitles are part of the picture. Their look can’t be changed.
player_style_note_image: Image subtitles are pictures, shown as they were made. Their look can’t be changed.
player_style_note_styled: Styled (ASS) subtitles keep the file’s own fonts, colors and placement. Only Size applies, as a scale.
player_subtitles_burn_note: {player} can’t draw {format} subtitles, so the server burns {name} into the picture. That converts the video; any other track goes back to {back}.
player_subtitles_preparing_note: This file was just added. Streamline is still preparing its subtitles; they show up here in about a minute.
player_sync_earlier: Subtitles show earlier than in the file.
player_sync_later: Subtitles show later than in the file.
player_toast_quality_lowered: Quality lowered to {value} Mbit/s to stop buffering
player_toast_quality_lowered_note: Auto steps back up when your connection recovers.
search_field_placeholder: Search movies and shows in your library
search_request_hint: To add something new, request it from the Streamline web app.
search_voice_hint: Hold the mic button on your remote to search by voice
server_act_restart_desc: Streams in progress stop for about 10 seconds. Players reconnect on their own. Streamline keeps running.
server_act_rotate_desc: Makes a new secret and shows it once. Playback stops until the engine’s config has the new one.
server_apps_desc_one: {count} device, each with its own key in the device’s secure storage.
server_apps_desc_other: {count} devices, each with its own key in the device’s secure storage.
server_ask_restart_body_none: Nobody is watching. The engine is back in about 10 seconds. You can still abort for 10 seconds after this.
server_ask_restart_body_one: {count} stream in progress stops for about 10 seconds, then players reconnect on their own. You can still abort for 10 seconds after this.
server_ask_restart_body_other: {count} streams in progress stop for about 10 seconds, then players reconnect on their own. You can still abort for 10 seconds after this.
server_ask_restart_ph: Shown on their screens before playback pauses
server_ask_stop_body: {what} on {device}. Playback stops on {name}’s screen right away.
server_ask_stop_ph: Shown on their screen when playback stops
server_ask_stop_ph_you: Shown to whoever is watching when playback stops
server_blk_browsers_desc: Signed in through Streamline from a web browser.
server_blk_cache_desc: Converted segments are kept while a stream runs, so seeking back doesn’t convert twice.
server_blk_folders_desc: A scan compares what Streamline holds with what the player has prepared.
server_blk_ready_desc: After each import or scan, the engine prepares new files: subtitles every player reads, previews for the scrubber, and where intros start and end.
server_blk_secret_desc: The engine only answers the player when its requests carry this secret. Put it in the engine’s config file as secret.
server_blk_waiting_desc: Check the code matches the one on the TV and pick who it belongs to: their watch history and Continue row follow it. Codes expire after 10 minutes.
server_desc_app_links: Phones and tablets come back to the app through these links. Desktop apps may always use 127.0.0.1.
server_desc_engine_public_url: Players fetch video from here, so remote viewers must reach it.
server_desc_engine_url: Inside your network. List its host and port under hosts for the player extension in Streamline’s config file.
server_desc_hw_accel: Auto uses VAAPI when the device answers and falls back to the CPU.
server_desc_max_live: Players past this limit wait for a free slot.
server_desc_network_home: Devices on these networks are at home and use their home quality.
server_desc_player_origins: Sign-in only returns to these addresses: scheme, host and port, nothing after.
server_desc_player_url: TVs show this address, with their code, in the pairing link and the QR code.
server_desc_tonemap: Tone-maps HDR10 and Dolby Vision for players that can’t show HDR. Off sends HDR as-is and colors look washed out.
server_hw_status_desc: Checked with a short test encode after every change.
server_kept_desc: Streamline’s own settings and its logs are managed in Streamline, at {host}. They open in your browser.
server_kv_dovi_desc: Turns profile 7 into 8.1 for players that can’t read 7.
server_kv_secret_desc: It is shown once, when it is made. Lost it? Rotate it and update the engine.
server_late: The engine hasn’t come back yet.
server_note_cache_cleared: Cache cleared. Streams in progress rebuild what they need.
server_note_no_secret: No secret yet. Nobody can play anything until you make one and put it in the engine’s config.
server_open_import_desc: Where new files come from and when Streamline looks for them
server_open_logs_desc: What Streamline and its extensions write, the player included
server_restart_note_one: {count} change only applies after a restart: {keys}.
server_restart_note_other: {count} changes only apply after a restart: {keys}.
server_ro_body: This instance is configured externally and runs read-only. Editing controls are disabled.
server_ro_lock: Read-only mode — configuration changes are disabled on this instance.
server_sec_access_intro: Where the web player lives, where sign-in may return to, and which networks count as home.
server_sec_devices_intro: TVs paired with this server, and the apps and browsers signed in through Streamline. A TV shows a code; you choose whose TV it becomes when you approve it.
server_sec_engine_intro: Where the player reaches the engine, and the secret they share.
server_sec_library_intro: The folders Streamline imports into, and how the player gets their files ready to play.
server_sec_overview_intro: What the engine runs, whether the player reaches it, and anything that needs attention.
server_sec_streams_intro: Everyone watching right now, and whether the engine sends the original file or converts it on the way.
server_sec_transcoding_intro: When a player can’t decode a file, the engine converts it with ffmpeg while it plays.
server_secret_body_a: Put it in the engine’s config file as
server_secret_body_b: , then restart the engine. Until then, nothing plays.
server_secret_title: Copy it now: it won’t be shown again
server_tile_needs_secret: Playback is off until the engine has one
server_toast_revoked: Device key revoked · it has to pair again
settings_account_change_desc: Sign in to {host} on a phone or computer to change your name or email.
settings_cellular_desc: Caps Auto while this device is on mobile data.
settings_pair_tv_desc_web: A TV showing a code? Enter it here and the TV signs in as you.
settings_pair_tv_desc_app: A TV showing a code? Approve it in your browser at {address}, and the TV signs in as you.
settings_account_link_desc: Kept by Streamline. You change them on your Streamline account page, at {host}.
settings_anime_desc: For anime, play the Japanese audio with full {language} subtitles, whatever Audio language and Subtitles say.
settings_app_language_desc_emails: Menus, buttons, and the emails the server sends you.
settings_auto_skip_desc: Uses the intro markers Streamline finds when it scans an episode.
settings_can_play_desc: Reported by {player}. Files in these formats play as-is; the server converts the rest.
settings_device_key_desc: Created when you paired. It never leaves secure storage and is never shown to the app’s web layer.
settings_dts_desc: Only pass DTS through if your receiver supports it. With Decode here, the server converts it to E-AC-3.
settings_eac3_desc: Pass through sends the original audio to your TV or receiver, Atmos included. Decode here turns it into PCM on this device.
settings_err_picture_large: That picture is larger than 512 KB.
settings_err_picture_type: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP picture.
settings_frame_rate_desc: Switches the TV to the video’s frame rate so motion doesn’t judder; the picture goes dark for a moment. On start switches when a video starts and back when it stops. Always also follows rate changes between episodes.
settings_name_desc: Other people on this server see this name.
settings_picture_desc: Shown next to your name on this server and in every app.
settings_preview_cue: Keep your voice down. The hallway listens.
settings_quality_away_desc: Auto picks what your connection can hold and steps down instead of buffering.
settings_quality_home_desc: On the same network as {host}. Original plays the file as-is whenever this device can.
settings_role_desc_admin: Admins manage this server from Server settings.
settings_session_desc: Kept in this browser’s storage. Signing out ends this session only.
settings_sign_out_body: It loses its key right away and stops anything playing. To use it again, pair it with a new code.
settings_sign_out_browser_desc: Ends the session in this browser. Your other devices stay signed in.
settings_sign_out_desc: Removes the device key. You’ll need to pair again.
settings_signed_out_device: Signed out · {name} has to pair again
settings_subtitles_desc: Auto shows subtitles in your language when the audio is in another one, and only the forced ones otherwise.
settings_tech_details_desc: Codecs, bitrates, file names, and whether a stream is copied or converted. Off keeps it to 4K, HDR and Atmos.
settings_titles_synopses_desc: Comes with the library, the same for everyone on this server.
settings_truehd_desc: This device can’t decode TrueHD itself: with Decode here, the server converts it to E-AC-3.
settings_video_player_desc: Plays most files as they are, TrueHD and DTS included.
shell_narrow: Streamline Player needs a wider window.
signin_error_expired: That sign-in link expired. Try again.
signin_note: Opens Streamline’s sign-in page: use single sign-on or your email, as you do there.
signin_note_app: Opens Streamline’s sign-in page in your browser: use single sign-on or your email, as you do there.
welcome_bad_address: That doesn’t look like an address
welcome_lead_pair: On your phone, open the pairing page and enter this code. You only need to do this once.
welcome_lead_paired: Signed in as {name}. Nobody typed a password on this TV.
welcome_lead_server: Enter the address you use for the Streamline web app.
welcome_not_streamline: {host} answered, but not as a Streamline server
welcome_paired_lead: This computer now signs in as you on {host}.
welcome_paired_lead_tablet: This tablet now signs in as you on {host}.
welcome_pairing_refused: The server refused to start pairing
welcome_qr_alt: QR code for the pairing page
welcome_scan: Scan with your phone, or open
welcome_server_help: The same address as the Streamline web app.
welcome_server_lead: Streamline Player streams from your own Streamline server. Enter the address you use for its web app.
welcome_type_hint: Type with the remote, or press Continue.
card_lang_hint_series: Applies to every season of {title}, including new episodes.
detail_reset_episode_text: S{season} E{episode} is back to not started
detail_subs_note: Forced English subtitles turn on automatically when the original audio isn’t English.
dl_ask_many_body: {size} come off this device. You can download them again any time.
dl_ask_one_body: {size} comes off this device. You can download it again any time.
search_phone_requests: Requests live in the Streamline web app.
signin_phone_lead: Use your Streamline account. You’ll only do this once.
welcome_phone_paired_lead: Signed in as {name}. The device key is in {keystore}.
dl_wifi_note_on: Downloads wait for Wi-Fi. Change this in Settings.
dl_wifi_note_off: Downloads also run on cellular data.
halt_missing_note_admin: If it was moved, a library scan finds it again.
halt_nocodec_note_admin: Turn on software conversion in Server settings → Transcoding (slower, it uses the CPU), or play it on another device.
player_audio_note_pass: {name} goes to your TV or receiver as-is (pass-through).
player_audio_note_pass_off: Pass-through is off for {name} and this device can’t decode it, so the server converts it to {out}. Change it in Settings → This device.
detail_toast_scan_text: New and changed files are processed again
